title: Beneficial ownership identification and reporting
definition: The requirement, for a covered financial institution, to identify and verify the natural persons who ultimately own or control a legal entity customer, to the threshold stated in the rule, and to obtain and maintain a certification from the customer. A customer that has certified the information for a previous verification is not required to collect it again, and a customer with more owners than the rule permits may be exempted from certification. This record summarises the requirement.
evidence_to_cite: the ownership and control evidence for the entity customer
the certification obtained, with its date
any reliance on a previous certification, and the basis for it

sources.citation: Beneficial ownership identification and certification requirements (31 CFR 1010.230), summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
